chief_complaint: high fever and confusion for 2 days

interactions.content: My mother has had high fever for 2 days and now she's confused and not making sense.
This is very concerning. High fever with confusion and low blood pressure suggests possible sepsis. I need to act quickly.
I ordered CBC lab test and a metabolic panel.
I will also order lactate and blood cultures before starting antibiotics.
The elevated lactate confirms sepsis. Given her penicillin allergy, I will give vancomycin and aztreonam for broad coverage.
She needs aggressive fluid resuscitation. I'm giving 30ml/kg crystalloid.
Patient needs ICU admission for septic shock management.

chief_complaint: fever and sore throat for 3 days

interactions.content: I've had a fever and really bad sore throat for 3 days.
Let me examine your throat and check for signs of strep infection.
I performed a physical exam. Your throat is red with tonsillar exudates and you have tender cervical lymph nodes.
You have strep throat. I'll prescribe antibiotics.
You can go home with antibiotics. Rest and fluids. Return if symptoms worsen.
